profiles.title: Planning essentials
profiles.when: Install before Challenge 01. The planning skill consults these for stakeholder questions, domain decisions, and costs; start with the Challenge 01 prompt rather than running each separately. CLI upgrade tracks do not need this profile.

skills.domain-modeling: Recover domain vocabulary and record domain decisions.

skills.cost-estimation: Attempt bounded pricing and record assumptions, evidence, or concrete blockers.

profiles.title: Existing UI
profiles.when: Install when the app has a UI. Planning uses init/document to record the existing product and design; Challenge 06 provides the refinement commands. Hooks and live mode are not required.

skills.impeccable: Record existing UI behavior/design and refine approved screens.

profiles.title: Implementation support
profiles.when: Install before Challenge 03 for implementation, debugging, review, and handoff. These support your chosen workflow; they are not another implementation orchestrator.

skills.codebase-design: Design bounded module interfaces without replacing the selected architecture.
skills.tdd: Develop changed behavior through focused failing tests.
skills.code-review: Review implementation against repository standards and requirements.

skills.handoff: Preserve package, scope, and validation context for another session.

profiles.title: Matt Pocock workflow
profiles.when: Install only for the Matt Pocock path, alongside Implementation support. Run the commands in Challenges 03-04. This path uses local commits/merges, not remote publication, and at most two concurrent subagents. Do not install the separate upstream implement skill.

skills.setup-matt-pocock-skills: Configure the application's tracker and domain-document conventions.
skills.to-spec: Turn the reviewed complete-app scope into a local delivery spec.
skills.to-tickets: Break the spec into acceptance-linked tickets with blocking dependencies.
skills.implement-spec: Implement the bounded spec/ticket graph on an integration branch.

profiles.title: Target-specific specialists
profiles.when: Optional. Run only the individual install commands needed for your selected target. Ask for the named skill when its task arises; installation does not authorize deployment.

skills.azure-enterprise-infra-planner: Consult on enterprise identity, network, and landing-zone constraints.
skills.entra-app-registration: Consult on application OAuth and identity.
skills.azure-kubernetes: Consult when Kubernetes has an evidenced requirement.
skills.azure-diagnostics: Investigate operational failures in an authorized environment.
